title: Uncommon Ground
venue_description:
About Uncommon Ground

Uncommon Ground has been a Lakeview institution for over 25 years establishing itself as home to Chicagos best open mic night. The venue combines live music with sustainable dining featuring an on-site organic brewery.

Open Mic Legacy

The Shure-sponsored open mic runs every Sunday and has launched the careers of numerous Chicago musicians. The competitive format includes weekly winners semi-finals and an annual finale with prizes including microphones studio time and cash awards.

Dining Experience

The restaurant serves modern American cuisine with a focus on local and organic ingredients. Full dinner service is available during performances with seating available from 4pm. The venue also features Greenstar Brewing offering award-winning organic beers.

Additional Events

Beyond the weekly open mic Uncommon Ground hosts touring singer-songwriters indie artists and local bands. The venue provides an intimate setting for acoustic performances and full-band shows.

title: Rosa's Lounge
venue_description:
About Rosa's Lounge

Since opening in 1984 Rosa's Lounge has been Chicagos friendliest blues lounge and a cornerstone of the citys blues scene. This intimate 100-capacity venue in Logan Square has hosted blues legends and continues to nurture emerging talent.

Blues Jam History

Rosa's Blues Jam has been a proving ground for blues musicians for over 40 years. Legendary artists including Chico Chism Buddy Scott Valerie Wellington James Wheeler Melvin Taylor Sugar Blue Lil Ed Willie Buck and Mary Lane have all graced the stage. The monthly jam session hosted by drummer David Levit focuses on classic blues repertoire and respecting the genres roots.

Rosa's Lounge Records

In 2025 the venue launched its own independent record label Rosa's Lounge Records to spotlight unrecorded Chicago talent. The label operates as a joint venture allowing artists to retain their music rights while licensing to the label.

Live Music Schedule

The venue features live blues performances multiple nights per week showcasing both established artists and up-and-coming musicians. Rosa's has become known for authentic blues performances that attract both longtime fans and younger audiences discovering the genre.

title: Andy's Jazz Club
venue_description:
About Andy's Jazz Club

Andy's Jazz Club is one of Chicagos most respected jazz venues located in the heart of downtown just two blocks from The Magnificent Mile. The club has been presenting live jazz for decades maintaining a commitment to authentic performance.

The Last Minute Jam

Every Wednesday at 10pm Andy's hosts The Last Minute Jam Session led by drummer Charles Rick Heath. Musicians sign in at the piano upon arrival to be called up to perform jazz standards. The session brings together professional artists and emerging musicians creating collaborative performances.

Daily Jazz Programming

Andy's presents live jazz seven nights a week with multiple sets each evening. The venue features local Chicago musicians as well as touring artists covering a range of jazz styles from traditional to contemporary.

Atmosphere

The club provides an intimate setting for jazz with excellent sightlines and acoustics. The venue serves food and drinks creating a classic jazz club atmosphere.

title: Jazz Showcase
venue_description:
About Jazz Showcase

Jazz Showcase is a legendary Chicago venue with a storied history of presenting world-class jazz artists and supporting jazz education. The club continues to be a vital part of Chicagos jazz scene.

Jazz Links Program

The Jazz Links Jam Sessions provide a unique opportunity for student musicians ages 9-19 to perform with professional mentors. These free public events occur monthly from September through May allowing students to develop their skills in a supportive environment. Students sign up on-site and perform jazz standards they know from memory.

Professional Performances

Jazz Showcase hosts top-tier professional jazz acts year-round featuring both legendary performers and emerging artists. The venues commitment to presenting quality jazz spans multiple generations.

Educational Mission

Through Jazz Links and other programs the venue maintains a strong focus on jazz education ensuring the next generation of musicians can learn from professionals and gain performance experience.

title: Buddy Guy's Legends
venue_description:
About Buddy Guy's Legends

Founded by Chicago blues legend Buddy Guy this South Loop venue has been a blues institution for over 30 years. The club embodies the spirit of Chicago blues while supporting the genres continued evolution.

Weekly Blues Jam

Every Wednesday night Buddy Guy's Legends hosts an open blues jam led by Brother John or Jimmy Burns. Musicians can sign up to sit in with the house band playing classic blues repertoire. The jam maintains high musical standards while welcoming players of various experience levels.

Live Blues Seven Nights

The venue features live blues performances every night of the week showcasing local Chicago blues artists as well as national touring acts. The stage has hosted countless blues legends and continues to present the best in Chicago and American blues.

Atmosphere and Dining

Buddy Guys Legends offers Cajun and Southern cuisine alongside the music creating an authentic blues club experience. The venue features memorabilia and photographs celebrating blues history.

title: Judson Moore Distillery
venue_description:
About Judson Moore Distillery

Judson Moore Distillery combines craft spirits with live music creating a unique venue for community gatherings and musical events. Located in Chicagos Avondale neighborhood the distillery provides an intimate setting for performances.

Bluegrass Breakdown

The monthly Bluegrass Breakdown jam session launched in December 2023 brings together Chicagos bluegrass community. Hosted by Aaron Smith the jam focuses on traditional bluegrass and old-time music while encouraging musicians of all levels to participate. The session emphasizes community building and provides opportunities to meet fellow bluegrass enthusiasts.

Other Events

Beyond bluegrass the distillery hosts various live music events and community gatherings. The venue provides a welcoming atmosphere for acoustic music and intimate performances.

title: The Green Mill
venue_description:
About The Green Mill

The Green Mill is a legendary Chicago jazz club with a history dating back over 100 years. Operating continuously since the 1900s including through the Prohibition era as a speakeasy the venue is steeped in jazz history.

Historic Venue

Tunnels beneath the Green Mill were used to smuggle alcohol during Prohibition and provided escape routes during police raids. The club has maintained its authentic vintage atmosphere and continues to be one of Americas most important jazz venues.

Live Jazz

The Green Mill features live jazz every night of the week presenting both top Chicago musicians and national touring artists. The venues excellent acoustics and intimate setting provide an unparalleled jazz experience.

Cultural Significance

Beyond jazz the Green Mill is also known for hosting the Uptown Poetry Slam and maintaining its connection to Chicagos cultural heritage. The venue represents the living history of American jazz.
